_doc: Menu layout of the original (GOG 2.0.0.5) as data for tools/orig/macros.py. Coordinates are FRACTIONS of the game frame (menus: 800x600), measured from Wine-runner screenshots 2026-10-22 (T16; docs/testing/original-wine.md section 2 gives the same points in virtual-desktop pixels). Screen names refer to tools/orig/screens_sig.json. When T15's screens.json (PR #16) is on main, this merges into its menu_navigation block.

intros._note: two intro videos before the main menu, each skipped with ESC or a click (owner, 2026-10-22; confirmed: 2 skips in the Wine runner)

options_graphics._note: main-menu Options = graphics only (resolution, details); no sound settings here. ESC does not leave it, Back does.
